note: Trials (roadmap item 67; core/game/game_trials.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd; see docs/TRIALS.md). Every number is a guess until measured. A realm lists its pool of trials; `placed` picks `place_min` to `place_max` of them for a world seed. Each trial: focus, length in world hours, gate (level, classes, an earlier trial), check (stat and difficulty: chance = score / (score + difficulty), kept within check_min..check_max), risk (hurt takes hp_pct of max HP but never kills; cost takes gold), gain (a stat bonus in trait terms, `legacy` passes to heirs) or Lore (a list of spells and feats, the first that suits the heir's class, else the fallback), a drawback for Pact, a master (a creature of data/creatures that runs the trial, with its lines), `fight` (the trial is won by beating the master), and a quest of steps the heir must finish before it can start (visit a place, offer gold, reach a level).

text.not_placed: That trial does not stand in this world.
text.realm_closed: The way to that realm is shut.
text.wrong_class: The trial is not for your calling.
text.quest_open: {master} will not begin until the way in is done: {step}
text.retry_wait: Wait {hours} more hours before trying again.
text.not_ready: {trial} is not over yet: {hours} hours to go.
text.no_step: The way in is done already.
text.quest_done: The way in to {trial} is done.
text.gain_capped: The gain is already at its limit.
text.fight_first: {master} must be beaten in a fight.
text.fight_not_run: This trial is not won by a fight.
text.site_hint: A trial stands here: {trial}, run by {master}. Use to speak with them.
text.preview_lore: a spell or feat your calling can use

quest.name: The Stone Lift: the way in

steps.text: Word of The Stone Lift is heard at Hearthmere; go and find the site.
steps.done: You find the way to The Stone Lift.

steps.text: the Stone Warden asks an offering of 30 gold before it will test you.
steps.done: the Stone Warden takes the offering and nods.

steps.text: A last errand: be seen at Ironford so the warden knows you.
steps.done: The warden has heard of you.

lines.opening: The Stone Warden grinds upright. 'Lift what I lift, and carry it as long as I do.'
stages: Walk with it. Do not let it down.
Hold. The stone does not tire; you must not.
lines.success: The Stone Warden sets down its slab. 'Your back will remember this.'
lines.failure: The slab slips. The Stone Warden says only: 'Again, when you are stronger.'

quest.name: The Vigil of Embers: the way in

steps.text: Word of The Vigil of Embers is heard at Greenvale; go and find the site.
steps.done: You find the way to The Vigil of Embers.

steps.text: the Pale Keeper asks an offering of 35 gold before it will test you.
steps.done: the Pale Keeper takes the offering and nods.

steps.text: A last errand: be seen at Whisperwood so the warden knows you.
steps.done: The warden has heard of you.

lines.opening: The Pale Keeper floats beside a low fire. 'Watch until the last ember. Do not look away.'
stages: Watch the fire. Voices begin to whisper.
The whispers name your fears. Do not answer.
Only embers remain, and something stands behind you.
lines.success: The last ember dies. 'You were afraid, and you stayed,' says the Pale Keeper.
lines.failure: You look away. The fire goes out and the Keeper fades.

lines.opening: The Archivist turns a page with a dry finger. 'Read what suits your hand.'
stages: Find the shelf that is yours.
The text is in no language you know. Read it anyway.
The last page asks you to say it aloud.
lines.success: The Archivist closes the book. 'It is yours now. Use it well.'
lines.failure: The page crumbles. 'You were not ready,' says the Archivist.

lines.failure: You are put on the sand. The Ring Champion says: 'Come back sharper.'
